turns.patient_response:
Hello, Dr. Smith. Well, I came in because my eating has just gotten all turned around. It's been going on for months now. 

Some days I just pick at a piece of toast and have a cup of coffee, and that's it. But then other days, I'll find myself standing in the bakery aisle at the store buying a bunch of sweets that I don't even really enjoy eating. It's just very all over the place.
